mapper.sql: id, profile_id, experience_type, title, organization, start_date, end_date, is_current, description_md, sort_order, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_profile_experience (profile_id, experience_type, title, organization, start_date, end_date, is_current, description_md, sort_order, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{profileId}, #{experienceType}, #{title}, #{organization}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{isCurrent}, #{descriptionMd}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sr_profile_experience WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} AND status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_profile_experience WHERE profile_id = #{profileId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_profile_experience SET experience_type = #{experienceType}, title = #{title}, organization = #{organization}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, is_current = #{isCurrent}, description_md = #{descriptionMd}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
